children: OpenAI is set to preview a cybersecurity-focused artificial intelligence model, GPT-6 Cyber, within days and launch a new product designed to help customers deploy it more securely and automatically, Fortune reported on Thursday, citing myltiple sources familiar with the plans.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report. OpenAI did not immediately respond to a Reuters' request for comment outside regular business hours.
